Rashi on Sotah 35a:10:1.hebrew: ה"ג ולא היא כי הוו מברי אבילי תותי ארזי הוו מברי - ולא היו שקרנים בזאת (ולא היו נראים בהן שקרנים), דאינהו שמעינהו לאמוריים שקורין אותן חגבים. דכי הוו אמוריים מברין את אביליהם כשחוזרין מן הקבר — כדאמר לעיל דכל היכא דמטו שכיב חשיבא מנייהו, ומברין לאבל סעודה לנחמו — תותי ארזי הוו מברי להו:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:10:1.english: This is the reading: But [that] is not so, when they were having the mourners' meal, they had the meal beneath cedar trees - And they were not liars in this [matter] (and they did not appear as liars regarding them), for they [actually] heard the Amorites calling them grasshoppers. For when the Amorites would serve the mourners' meal to their mourners upon returning from the grave — as [the Gemara] stated above, that wherever [the spies] arrived, a prominent person among them died, and they would serve a meal to the mourner to comfort him — they would serve them [the meal] beneath cedar trees.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:10:2.hebrew: וכדחזינהו - והם יראים לעמוד לפניהם, סלקי ויתבי באילני:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:10:2.english: And when they saw them - and they were afraid to stand before them, [so] they climbed up and sat in the trees.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:12:1.english: And they threw them upward - [The phrase] "to stone them" refers also to "the glory of the Lord."

Rashi on Sotah 35a:13:1.hebrew: במגפה - מדלא קרינן במגפה, משמע במיוחדת וראויה להם במדה כנגד מדה:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:13:1.english: By the plague [bamagefah] - Since we do not read bemagefah ["by a plague"], it implies [a plague] designated and fitting for them, measure for measure.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:13:2.hebrew: באסכרה מתו - שהיא באה על לשון הרע, כדאמרינן בבמה מדליקין (שבת דף לג:):
Rashi on Sotah 35a:13:2.english: They died of diphtheria - For it comes on account of slander, as we say in [the chapter] Bameh Madlikin (Shabbat 33b).

Rashi on Sotah 35a:14:1.hebrew: וכיון שעלה כו' - סיפא דברייתא דלעיל היא, אלא איידי דתנא בה ״ומכאן אתה מחשב לאשכול״, נקט לה לפרשת מרגלים הכא:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:14:1.english: And once [the last one] ascended, etc. - This is the latter part of the baraita above; rather, since it taught in it, "And from here you calculate [the size of] the cluster [of grapes]," it cited the passage of the spies here.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:14:2.hebrew: שבו המים למקומם - שהכהנים עמדו במקומם עד שעברו כל העם, וכשעברו נתקו כפות רגלי הכהנים אל החרבה ונמשכו לאחוריהם פסיעה אחת, נמצאו כהנים מצד זה כו'. ואע"ג דההוא קרא ד"ויהי כאשר תם כל העם לעבור" קדים, דמשמע דהאי "נתקו רגלי הכהנים" בעבר השני כתיב, לא הוי הכי, אלא אין מוקדם ומאוחר. דאי כסדרן כתיב, הא נפקי להו מן הירדן! דכתיב: "ויעבור ארון ה' והכהנים לפני העם" והעם עלו, וכיון דארון והכהנים עלו ועברו אחריהם עד שבאו לפניהם, הרי יצאו מן הירדן, ומאי תו דקאמר: "ויצו יהושע את הכהנים לאמר עלו מן הירדן"? אלא אין מוקדם ומאוחר, והאי "עלו מן הירדן" דקאמר להו, הכי קאמר להו: סלקו רגליכם לאחוריכם, ועודם בעבר המזרחית, וכתיב בתריה: "נתקו כפות רגלי הכהנים אל החרבה וישובו מי הירדן אל מקומם":
Rashi on Sotah 35a:14:2.english: The waters returned to their place - For the priests stood in their place until all the people had crossed, and when they had crossed, the soles of the priests' feet were drawn up unto the dry ground and they pulled themselves back one step; [thus] the priests were found on this side, etc. And even though that verse, "And it came to pass, when all the people had finished crossing" (Joshua 4:11), precedes [it]—which implies that this "the feet of the priests were drawn up" is written [as occurring] on the second [i.e., western] bank—it is not so; rather, there is no chronological order [in Scripture]. For if it were written in order, behold, they had [already] left the Jordan! For it is written, "and the Ark of the Lord and the priests crossed before the people," and the people ascended; and since the Ark and the priests ascended and crossed after them until they came before them, behold, they had [already] exited the Jordan, so what is this further [statement] that it says: "And Joshua commanded the priests, saying: Ascend from the Jordan" (Joshua 4:17)? Rather, there is no chronological order, and this "Ascend from the Jordan" that he said to them, this is what he said to them: "Withdraw your feet backward"—while they were still on the eastern bank—and it is written after it: "the soles of the priests' feet were drawn up unto the dry ground, and the waters of the Jordan returned to their place" (Joshua 4:18).

Rashi on Sotah 35a:15:1.hebrew: נשא ארון את נושאיו ועבר - והיינו קרא קמא, דכתיב: ויהי כאשר תם כל העם לעבור [ויעבור] ארון ה' וגו':
Rashi on Sotah 35a:15:1.english: The Ark carried its bearers and crossed - And this is the earlier verse, as it is written: “And it came to pass, when all the people had finished passing over, the Ark of the Lord passed over, etc.”

Rashi on Sotah 35a:17:1.english: On account of matters of his error - An inadvertent error that he committed by taking hold of it [the Ark].

Rashi on Sotah 35a:17:2.hebrew: שעשה צרכיו - ושל — לשון "כי ישל זיתך" (דברים כ״ח:מ׳) ו"בשלייתה" (שם) — דבר המוטל מלמעלה למטה:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:17:2.english: That he relieved himself - And shal [is] an expression [akin to] "for your olive [tree] shall cast off [yishal]" (Deuteronomy 28:40) and "her afterbirth [u'v'shilyatah]" (ibid.) — something that is cast down from above to below.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:18:1.hebrew: הארון קיים לעולם - שהרי נגנז, כדאמר ביומא (דף נב:) שגנזו יאשיהו:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:18:1.english: The Ark exists forever - For it was hidden away, as it says in Yoma (52b) that Josiah hid it.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:19:1.english: Ḥarara - A cake that is baked upon the coals.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:1:1.hebrew: וילכו ויבאו - לא גרסינן וכתיב. [אלא] וילכו יתירא הוא; כיון דכתיב [לעיל] וישובו, לא הוה ליה למימר אלא ויבאו אל משה וגו':
Rashi on Sotah 35a:1:1.english: And they went and they came - We do not read [the word] "and it is written" [in the Gemara]. Rather, "and they went" is superfluous; since it is written [above], "and they returned," [the verse] should only have said, "and they came to Moses, etc."

Rashi on Sotah 35a:1:2.english: [The verse] likens their going - when they went to spy out [the land], to their coming.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:1:3.english: So too, their going [was] with wicked counsel - For from the beginning, they intended to spread an evil report.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:21:1.english: David was punished - For Uzzah died on his account.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:21:2.hebrew: זמירות היו לי חוקיך בבית מגורי - כשהייתי בורח מפני אויבי ואגור מפניהם, הייתי משתעשע בחוקיך, והיו לי לזמירות לשעשעני:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:21:2.english: Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage - When I was fleeing from my enemies and would sojourn [in exile] because of them, I would delight in Your statutes, and they were songs to me to delight me.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:22:1.hebrew: התעיף - לשון [כפול], "וכפלת" מתרגמינן "ותיעוף" (שמות כז), שאם תכפיל עיניך לסתום עין בהסח הדעת מהסתכל בהן, מיד "ואיננו":
Rashi on Sotah 35a:22:1.english: Will you set [hata'if] - An expression of doubling; [for] "and you shall double" is translated [into Aramaic] as "ve-tei'of" (Exodus 27), [meaning] that if you fold your eyes — to close an eye in distraction from looking at them — immediately "it is gone."

Rashi on Sotah 35a:22:2.hebrew: לא נתן - עגלות משה לבני קהת, לפי שיש עליהם לשאת בכתף, כי לא היו ממונים אלא על דבר קדושת הארון והשולחן [והמנורה ומזבח הזהב]:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:22:2.english: He did not give - [Moses did not give] wagons to the sons of Kohath, because it was incumbent upon them to carry [them] upon the shoulder, for they were only appointed over the sacred matter of the Ark and the Table [and the Menorah and the Golden Altar].

Rashi on Sotah 35a:23:1.hebrew: ויך באנשי בית שמש - לא בהך הכאה דדוד כתיב, אלא כשהביאוהו הפרות מפלשתים, ואיידי דאיירי בארון נקט לה:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:23:1.english: And He smote of the men of Beit Shemesh - [This] is not written regarding that smiting of [the time of] David, rather [it refers to] when the cows brought it from the Philistines; and since [the Gemara] is dealing with the Ark, it mentions it.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:23:2.hebrew: משום דראו - ונסתכלו בו, ויך? בתמיה:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:23:2.english: Because they saw - and gazed upon it, He smote [them]? [This is asked] in astonishment.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:23:3.hebrew: קוצרין ומשתחוים היו - לא בטלו ממלאכתן לכבדו. והאי "ראו" לשון בזיון, כמו "אל תראוני שאני שחרחורת" (שיר השירים א׳:ו׳):
Rashi on Sotah 35a:23:3.english: They were reaping and prostrating themselves - They did not cease from their work to honor it. And this [word] "they gazed" [is] an expression of contempt, like "Do not gaze upon me because I am swarthy" (Song of Songs 1:6).

Rashi on Sotah 35a:2:1.hebrew: אינו מתקיים - שמחזיקין אותן השומעין כבדאין, לפיכך אומר דבר אמת תחילה כדי שיאמינו. ואף מרגלים לכך פתחו בשבח הארץ תחילה:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:2:1.english: It does not stand - For the listeners regard them as liars; therefore, [one] says a true thing at first so that they will believe [him]. And the spies too, for this reason, began with the praise of the land first.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:3:1.english: And he stilled - He silenced them.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:3:2.hebrew: אל משה - בדברים שהתחיל לדבר במשה, והיו סבורים שבגנותו רוצה לספר:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:3:2.english: Toward Moses - [He persuaded them] with words, for he began to speak about Moses, and they thought that he wanted to speak in disparagement of him.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:3:3.english: That he persuaded them with words - As [the Gemara] goes on to explain.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:4:1.hebrew: דחזייה - כלב ליהושע שרצה לדבר, ושיתקוהו בנזיפה ואמרו לו: ראש הקטוע ידבר? מי שראשו קטוע, שאין לו בנים ליטול חלק בארץ, הוא ידבר בפנינו:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:4:1.english: For he saw him - Caleb [saw] Joshua, that he wanted to speak, and they silenced him with a rebuke and said to him: "Shall the severed head speak? One whose head is severed, who has no children to take a portion in the Land, shall he speak before us?"

Rashi on Sotah 35a:5:1.english: And stop me - They silence me.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:6:1.english: We should go up at once - Even to the heavens, if he commands us.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:7:1.english: Than Him - Than the Holy One, Blessed be He.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:7:2.hebrew: אל תקרי - לא גרס, שאין הפרש קרייה בין ממנו הנאמר על יחיד שנדברים עליו, לממנו של רבים שאומרים על עצמן:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:7:2.english: Do not read - [We] do not have [this] reading, for there is no difference in pronunciation between mimmennu, which is said regarding an individual about whom they are speaking ["than Him"], and mimmennu of the plural, which they say regarding themselves ["than us"].

Rashi on Sotah 35a:7:3.english: He is unable to remove His belongings - If He deposited them there.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:7:4.english: The homeowner - The Master of the Universe.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:8:1.english: I intended it for good - That I showed it to them as consuming its inhabitants, [in] that [people] die in it constantly.

Rashi on Sotah 35a:8:2.hebrew: שכיב איוב - שלא תגין זכותו עליהם, והיינו דקאמר כלב: ״סר צלם מעליהם״:
Rashi on Sotah 35a:8:2.english: Job died - So that his merit would not protect them, and this is what Caleb said: "Their protection has departed from them."

Tosafot on Sotah 35a:13:1.english: "[This] teaches that they died an unusual death" - It appears that he expounded [the words] "evil by the plague".
